spec_match.rationale: Reads every attribute HTML's run-a-worker / SharedWorker-constructor steps set on the browser-fired connect MessageEvent (data, ports frozen array, source) plus untouched defaults, inside a real SharedWorkerGlobalScope.

interactive.rationale: Two buttons create a fresh-name worker (run a worker path) or reconnect to the same name (constructor path); a 10-row spec table and verdict update per connection.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index promises field-by-field readback with a spec verdict for both paths; delivered.

edge_cases.rationale: Covers both spec algorithms (new global vs existing global), legacy null with exact kill-switch flag, SharedWorker-unavailable fallback, and worker load/timeout errors.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/5142074717503488 and the relevant HTML spec section.

conformance.rationale: Feature suite (8 assertions) runs real blob-URL SharedWorkers: on Chrome 153 the three data assertions fail (legacy null) and the five shape/default assertions pass, exactly as the Chromium source predicts.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Chrome 153 headless desktop+mobile: both buttons exercised; connection #1 via run a worker and #2 via constructor both reported data null / typeof object, all other 8 fields matched spec; console clean, no failed requests. Only the legacy-null branch was observable on Chrome 153; the spec branch is the same code path reading a different engine value and is pinned by conformance.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts the real round-trip; legacy null is asserted as an explicit honest-unsupported fallback, never as a pass of the spec contract.

design_system.rationale: Only design-system CSS variables; verdict colours use --accent-emerald-dark / --accent-rose on ivory; buttons use the global black/ivory pair.

accessibility.rationale: Native buttons/radios/checkbox with visible labels, keyboard path verified (Enter on buttons, arrow keys in radio group, Tab to action), one polite status region, captioned tables in labelled focusable regions.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: No horizontal overflow at 360x740 DPR3 or 1280x800; tables stack under a container query; responsive-check harness ok on both classes.

openQuestions.title: Capture the spec branch on real Chrome 160+
openQuestions.detail: This container only has Chrome for Testing 153, where the connect event data is null (the Blink feature SharedWorkerConnectEventEmptyStringData does not exist there, so --enable-blink-features is a no-op). Run on Chrome 160+ and confirm data === "" plus the spec-branch telemetry assert; then compare against --disable-blink-features=SharedWorkerConnectEventEmptyStringData.

openQuestions.title: Inspect with chrome-devtools-mcp
openQuestions.detail: Verification used headless Chrome via Playwright (ariaSnapshot + keyboard path) because chrome-devtools-mcp is unavailable in the cloud routine (project rule 7b).

openQuestions.title: Confirm SharedWorker availability on Chrome for Android
openQuestions.detail: Mobile verification was emulated on desktop Chrome, where SharedWorker exists. Real Android Chrome exposure of SharedWorker should be confirmed; the page already shows a labelled unsupported state when typeof SharedWorker !== 'function'.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive data table without horizontal overflow on mobile
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Semantic table with caption inside a focusable role=region wrapper; use @container queries to switch to a stacked layout with injected header labels on narrow widths.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Every result table sits in a tabindex=0 role=region labelled by its caption, container-type:inline-size, and stacks with td::before attr(data-label) labels under a container breakpoint; caption also made display:block in stacked mode after a 360px screenshot showed it squeezed.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: scrollWidth === innerWidth at 360x740 DPR3 and 1280x800 (Playwright, Chrome 153); /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-chrome-platform-showcase/654081b3-9e1a-5f02-a6f0-8cd1f1e41633/scratchpad/sw/shots/m_fid_stage.png

guidanceConsulted.query: aria-live status region for asynchronous results
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Announce asynchronous results through a single polite status region; use native controls with accessible names.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: One role=status aria-live=polite verdict/summary per page updated after each worker reply; all controls are native buttons/radios/checkboxes with visible text labels.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Controls at least 44x44 CSS px on touch screens; leave spacing between targets.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: All demo buttons/labels have min-block-size 44px with gap spacing; inline reference links in prose/lists are exempt per WCAG 2.5.8.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: Playwright check: 0 buttons under 44px tall at 360px.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: No SharedWorker-specific guide exists in modern-web-guidance; the general js guide's async coordination advice applies (timeouts, explicit error paths).
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Exception recorded: no specific guide. Every worker round-trip has a 5 s timeout and onerror path that surfaces an error in the live region instead of hanging.

summary: Real SharedWorker demo verified headless on Chrome 153 (legacy null branch) at desktop and mobile with clean console; the Chrome 160 empty-string branch is pinned by the feature conformance suite and awaits a Chrome 160 capture.
